title: Take a Look at Your Office: How VergeSense Enables Smarter Workspace Trends
summary: Explore VergeSense insights in Smart Buildings Magazine on data‑guided office planning to reveal underused spaces, reduce ghost reservations, and optimize collaboration.
body_markdown:
By: Smart Buildings Magazine


In this Smart Buildings Magazine feature, VergeSense’s VP of Product Kanav Dhir explores current workspace trends and how organizations can assess their office setups through a modern lens. Leveraging real-time occupancy intelligence, VergeSense helps workplace leaders identify underutilized rooms, optimize spatial layout, and reduce ghost-bookings. Discover how data-driven strategies empower companies to adapt swiftly to hybrid work models while boosting efficiency and employee satisfaction.


[Read More](https://smartbuildingsmagazine.com/features/take-a-look-at-your-office)
